book.name: Kraisgo Geme Dualali Sę Pedelabo Po Jonbolo Ola Mani
book.commonName: Kraisgo Geme Dualali Sę Pedelabo Po Jonbolo Ola Mani
book.title: Kraisgo Geme Dualali Sę Pedelabo Po Jonbolo Ola Mani

content: Te kibu sipsip waigo te buku dąų wali nai a naga olama me badu nogo deli togwa sąwai

Tama eno suali, te kibu sipsip wai agai te buku, te dąų wali nai a naga olama me badu nogo si elalubo buku, te agai tolalubo eno suai, tama agai te buku dąų wali nai hasia me deli togwai. Tama eno odali, te bidibo ula elalubo hasa me si me si tomode me deligo agai te po wabo, te dogoni te dagalude be kulu wabo tiwai yai. Agai te po wai, “Nage asao,” po wai.

Tama eno ma tonono bilibadi, tama eno te tedela yai kibu hos asobo suali, tama te kibude duayali bidigo enesigi tolaluai. Tama augwaligo te bidi agabolo te wąbi hwįbo bomo aiyaba elalubo bidibolo mabo te tiwai madi augwaligo agabolo menama, tama aga sęba tagala palai. Tama te bidi aga pelama, te wąbi hwįbo bomo aiyaba elaluabo sę egi peyu, tama tiyu agai te wąbi hwįbo bomo aiyaba elaluabo bomo hauwa elalubao.
Tama te kibu sipsip wai agai te buku dąų wali nai me si wali togwa sąwai, tama te bidibo ula elalubo hasa me sigo wabo po eno odali, te hasa sigo te po wali, “Nage asao.”

Tama gasa kibu hos me pedalai, te mama yai. Tama te kibude dualasa asobo bidibolo augwaligo bomo mawai. Tama te bidi agai te tǫde we bidi tomode elalubo boi pibo sogo togolama, tama genuai wąbi hwįbo sogo gagalama, tama bidi dabe augwaligo augwa hasi bidi ela mubo sę gagalamainogo te bidibolo te bomo mawai. Tama tiyu, augwaligo te bidi agabolo te genuai poa pai hwą ge te sę emainogo mawai.

Tama te kibu sipsip waigo te buku dąų wali nai sela wali togwa sąwai, tama te bidibo ula elalubo nai selago wabo po eno odali, “Nage asao,” wali. Tama eno ma tonono bilibadi, tama eno te sisi yai kibu hos asobo suai. Tama te kibude duawali bidi agai nogode te walu dabe skel ebo nai tolaluai.

Tama eno odali, te bidibo ula elalubo hasa me si me si tomode me deligo pedauwalide wabo po, tama te pedauwalidu te we bidigo tubo nai mude te po wali, “Nago te tubo nai wit ge, te gego dwasianu sini pągąnama tama te naigo sęgę skel ela suao. Tama te nai abelabo masigi hasegelao, te genuai muao, te masigi sabo sę ebo bidigo deli sogo sabo masigi tiwai si ilao. Tama nago te masigi hauwa meni yai bagego tubo nai nogi bali, tede me tama tiao, te bali gego dwasianu sini me si me deli pągąnama, tama te naigo sęgę skel ela suao. Tama te nai bali sela abelabo masigi nogi genuai naga nogi yao, te sę ebo bidigo deli sogo sabo masigi tiwai si dao. Tiali goli, nago te tubo wel dali te tubo ąį wain si dolamuo,” te po wali.
Tama te kibu sipsip waigo te buku dąų wali nai me si me si wali te togwa sąwai, tama eno odali, te bidibo ula elalubo hasa tomode me deligo agai te po wali, “Nage asao.”

Te po obaso eno tonono ma bilali, tama eno sewa yai kibu hos me deli asobo suali. Tama bidi te kibu hosde dulaluali, tama te bidi aga nogi isibo kolesaga da wali. Tama isai bidi bidibo madi aga wali asai. Tama augwaligo te we bidi hani tigidali tomode buguluyu, tama hani me si me si nigilali. Tama augwali sibolo augwaligo te hani dabe tonalubo bomo mawai. Tama te bomogo augwali sigo te we bidi me habu badu ela muao wali, te poa pai ge hwągo hwįbogo ela muainogo, tama te nai nasi me eyu, te haniani gasi me eyu, tama te tǫde bidibo haniani uni hasago me ela tuyu tama elama augwali sigo te bomo selama, te we bidi me habu badu ela muao wali.

Tama te kibu sipsip waigo te buku dąų wali nai a naga wali togwai, tama eno suali, te isai bidigo noma bidi meba augwali te Godibolo maiabo nai ulubo alta sai dologode bidai. Polobadu te bidi dabe augwaligo Godigo po te we bidibolo pusubo sę eyu, tama te pode augwaligo homu kęą pai bidi dabe bidai. Tama tibaso, te boi bidi dabego augwali ela munama isai dao.

Tama te noma bidi augwaligo i bomonama weyu tama wai, “Tigidali nai tonalubo Genuai Bidi, nage magi sę me esiąyu wiegi yai mu bidibo, tama nago kolesaga te mu naga ebo dao. Te tǫde we bidi augwaligo dwai sę da dali elama, tama da ela muani. Tede dago homugo nago augwali dali po tų eyu, dago kanemede augwalibolo wei ponao. Nisu naga sogo bidai madigi tama nago augwalibolo wei nisu ponaibawe?” te po wai.

Tama agai bobobage tedela yai ugwa augwali deli delibolo mena mena pai, tama agai te po augwali dali wai, “Dage toma tuyu, olo dwasianu sogo nagamea pai bidi bidao. Tama nosali boi bidi dabe augwaligo dage dali deli sę yali bidi dabe me, duga ama dabe me ela muaibao, te augwaligo dage ela muani tiwai yaibao. Tama nosali augwaligo te ela muani bidi dabe nedebo usu ebaso da, te God agai dagego kanemede augwali wei ponaibao,” te po wai.

Tama eno tonono ma bilibadi agai te buku dąų wali nai a naga olama me badu nogo deli wali te togwai, tama eno suali, tǫde genuai tǫ mali pedalai. Tama giliga ge begelama, te sisi yai gagawai. Tama te polua genuai ebadi te mama yai, te kaneme tiwai mu pedalai.
Tama dagalude hǫ dabe tǫba tulaluyu, te ni kaya du te moni bomai wali asiyu sela sąyu tulalubo tiwai yai.

Tama te dagalu me aga tomode buguluyu, te somo bebe pelama dąų wabo tiwai yai. Tama tigidali bulu du me, te tamu ąį tomode elalubo dwasianu tǫ tigidali me, augwali memenege elama tama bidali bulu taga soai, tama augwali gasa buluba kilasa pai.

Tama te tǫde tuni bidi dabe dali, te genuai nogi yai bidi augwali me, te ami genuai bidi augwali me, te walu hauwa dali te masigi hauwa munalubo bidi badi, te bomo yai bidi augwali me, tama te tigidali bidi, te masigi sisąbo sę ebo bidi dabe me, te bugagia olo bidibo bidi dabe me, tigidali hodobo augwali te tǫ olua bede duala siyu ela bilai, tama te genuai bulu dude elalubo masigi dologoba teba duala sisa bilai.

Tama augwaligo te bulu du dali masigi dabe sibolo i weyu te po wai, “Dagego da mesega sigulao, te genuai tuni bidi duabo naide dulalubo bidigo da suidali weyu, tama te kibu sipsip waigo sębę elalubo te aga gesabidide da duala saio, agai da suidali.

Magi baso menio. Te genuai sogode te augwali sigo sębę elaluali te wei ponoyu dwai dene maiabo sogo dao, te megi pedalali dao. Tama niwai bidi aga doligulama te sę yainogo ebo aiyaba elaluaibawe? Te mu menio,” augwaligo te po wai.
